newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India buys April 10-14 fuel oil at around +$13.9/T.
newsitem.headline: India buys April 10-14 fuel oil at around +$13.9/T.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has bought 30,000 tonnes of 3.5-percent sulphur fuel oil for delivery in April at around $13.9 per tonne above spot Middle East quotes, industry sources said on Wednesday.
IOC has awarded the cargo was awarded to Middle East trader Fal Oil on a cost-and-freight (C-and-f) basis for April 10-14 deliery to Bombay on the Indian west coast, the sources said.
In its last fuel oil tender, IOC bought two 30,000-tonne 3.5-percent high sulphur fuel oil cargoes for April delivery.
One cargo was bought at $6 per tonne above spot MiddleEast quotes on a free-on-board basis and the other at $12.5 per tonne on a c-and-f basis, also above spot MiddleEast prices.
